reviews.title: Ads and overpriced
reviews.text:
This tool used to be good before AI was so easily accessible. Now it's just a basic magic wand eraser with incessant ads and requires a SUBSCRIPTION for ad-free.

There are no online services for this app, and no operating costs for the dev. A subscription model is so slimy.

Actual job unless you have the time to personally do it yourself which is really really hard because obviously we make a lot of mistakes as humans so not really the best app.
